dex.entry: A droplet-shaped seedling that lives in pools of forest dew. It is translucent, with a single seed-core visible inside its water-plant body. Impossibly tiny and translucent — a glowing dewdrop with eyes.

art.silhouette: Teardrop body of pale green water-gel, a tiny brown seed core at its centre, thin tendrils as limbs, enormous shiny eyes; ethereally small.
art.palette: Teardrop body of pale green water-gel, a tiny brown seed core at its centre, thin tendrils as limbs, enormous shiny eyes; ethereally small.
art.direction: Impossibly tiny and translucent — a glowing dewdrop with eyes. Players love hatching something this small.
